entities.name: Amalia Benavides Aguirre
entities.description: A young vampire scout and cartomancer from Torrezon on Ixalan whose faith in Aclazotz broke and who later explores the Multiverse with Kellan.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A man from Eldraine whom Amalia saves; Oko's son who becomes her companion.

entities.name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
entities.description: The leader of the pilgrim expedition who plans to awaken Aclazotz and sacrifices others.

entities.name: Bartolomé del Presidio
entities.description: Director of the Queen's Bay Company who looked after Amalia and sacrificed himself so she and Kellan could escape.

entities.name: Clavileño
entities.description: An expedition member who partially turns to smoke to mark solid spots.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: The ancient bat god of night and creator of the first vampires, defeated after turning the vampires into demons.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Leader of a Sun Empire expedition party that appeared at the Core.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Kellan's father, whom Kellan looks for in Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A companion who returned to the surface with Kellan and Amalia.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A companion who returned to the surface with Kellan and Amalia.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A figure working with Kellan on the case of Zegana's murder.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: A murder victim whose case Kellan and Kaya worked.

entities.name: Antifex
entities.description: A figure Amalia feared Vito followed.

entities.name: Oltecs
entities.description: The native people of Ixalan's Core who would be wiped out if Aclazotz regained full power.

entities.name: Queen's Bay Company
entities.description: The company that hired Amalia as cartographer.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The faction whose expedition appeared in the Core.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: The agency Kellan got a job with on Ravnica.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: Amalia's home plane.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: Amalia's home city on Ixalan.

entities.name: Temple of Aclazotz
entities.description: The ruined temple the expedition searched for and entered.

entities.name: Core
entities.description: Ixalan's legendary Core where Aclazotz was held.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane Kellan and Amalia travel to.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The newly settled plane Kellan and Amalia map.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion after which Amalia took her cartographer post.

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion Amalia becomes cartographer for the Queen's Bay Company and joins Vito's expedition seeking the Temple of Aclazotz.
events.quote: took the position of cartographer for the Queen's Bay Company

events.summary: Vito reveals the mission is to awaken Aclazotz and bring him to Torrezon.
events.quote: Vito declared their expedition's mission was to awaken Aclazotz

events.summary: Vito sacrifices a human porter to open the temple door while Amalia objects and Bartolomé protests.
events.quote: Vito slit his throat to open the door

events.summary: Amalia uses her maps and quill to erase a bridge beneath goblins chasing Kellan, saving him and convincing Vito to let him join.
events.quote: Amalia caused the bridge beneath the man and the pursuing goblins to vanish

events.summary: At the Core a Sun Empire party led by Huatli appears and the vampires are imprisoned, but all except Amalia break out to free Aclazotz.
events.quote: all besides Amalia broke out to pursue Vito's goal

events.summary: Vito plans to sacrifice Kellan; Amalia and Bartolomé refuse, Bartolomé is killed as a sacrifice, and Amalia and Kellan side with the Oltecs.
events.quote: Bartolomé bought enough time to allow her and Kellan to escape, sacrificing himself

events.summary: After the god and his vampire minions are defeated, Amalia offers to accompany Kellan and they go through an Omenpath together.
events.quote: He was surprised when Amalia offered to accompany him

events.summary: On Ravnica Kellan works for the Agency while Amalia researches the plane and a Gruul ruin.
events.quote: Amalia researched the plane and its history

events.summary: Kellan settles on Thunder Junction after Oko leaves, and Amalia joins him to map the new plane.
events.quote: the two set off to map the newly-settled plane

relations.quote: Kellan returned to the surface with Amalia
took the position of cartographer for the Queen's Bay Company
she and Bartolomé refused to go through with his mad plan
Vito killed him and used him as a sacrifice instead
